answer: Split-View Nonce Quoting. Each identity must attach a fresh nonce to every outbound action; peers gossip received nonces through a slow, glacier-paced overlay, so a duplicate identity acting in two places emits conflicting nonce chains that eventually surface. A falcon relay flags divergence without permission. Cost: an attacker cloning an identity must partition all its counterparties or buy distinct nonce streams per copy, and any missed split publishes the collision. Willow-thin margins collapse fast.
